checks.name: Stopped invisible dock does not intercept the first lower-viewport footer tap
Served production bytes stay exact and loaded runtime has no JS/SRI faults

limitations: Isolated headless Linux Chromium; no physical Android display, OS picker, screen lock, or audible sound claim.
Service workers are blocked by the existing engineering fixture. This suite does not validate SW activation.

Picker work does not play audio. Dock setup installs one generated12-second personal WAV in the isolated profile and observes its real native media clock; no controlled TTS completion drives dock playback.
Every application request must succeed; exact served bytes and JavaScript/SRI errors are checked.
